title: On a video, Captions and Transitions sit where the user decides
goal: On a video the right panel still stacks Captions and Transitions at the foot of the picked clip's own settings. The user chose a split panel with the lists in a pane at the bottom; this asks whether those two join that pane on a video, given that on a laptop window doing so pushes a picked sound's Fades below the fold.
notes: Split out of the-right-panel-shows-only-what-the-picked-thing (2026-10-13). Measured on the laptop window (windowLaptop, sound picked): with Captions and Transitions in the pane at 40 per cent of a ~395pt column, the pick part was 235pt and Fades (244-352) fell under it; sound-fades-in-the-panel-walk step 12 and video-panel-order-walk step 45 failed. Both are forms the pane cannot shorten (not in DockMetrics.scrollingSections). Code: PanelListsPane.listSections (PhotonzCore), InspectorPanel.paneSplit.
